note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Quilly was the only contest; the remaining divisions were filled without opposition. Returned unopposed; sitting member. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Skeogh' to Skeagh (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Banbridge Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Skeagh; the rounds were filed as Skeagh (1927, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961); Skeogh (1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1964, 1967). This round was filed as 'Skeogh', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (skeogh) answers with a redirect to this one.
